title: Latent daily review · Oct 11
tldr: No new fixes from me today. Nothing new was a clear, unfixed code bug, so I launched no Cloud Agents and made no Linear issue.
27 more people chose “Stay as a Beta Tester” since yesterday's dig (18 left an email, 9 only a phone number). None of the beta stayers or tridha have a reply from you yet.

Two new email replies: Radhya wrote back that she's logged 15+ hours in 2 days and shared Latent with a small study influencer, and mbuteler answered the launch email with “Too late Eddie, dropped college alr🥲”. Drafts below.
Merged overnight: your #469 (one bad email address no longer breaks the whole batch of 100) and Malcolm's #470 (PostHog only sends profile details when they change). Malcolm's #463 is still open.

In-app: nothing new. Survey unchanged (39/25/2 of 66). Sentry: 5 new one-person freezes/crashes (APPLE-IOS-6K, 6M, 6N, 6P, 6Q). PostHog: group loading failures went up to 186 from 45 people, but they're almost all network errors (no clear code bug). Discord wasn't checked.

replyDrafts.subject: Re: TestFlight beta feedback for Latent
replyDrafts.theirMessage:
Heyy
I don’t know my when i entered my age on latent (15 year old) it deleted my acc saying its for 13 and above. I had a 3 week long streak as well. Please help me, i don’t want to lose everything please

I am a high schooler and this really means a lot to me. Please i have trust in you that you’ll brung my account back. Please.
replyDrafts.body:
Hey Tridha, I'm so sorry this happened, that's a really rough way to lose a 3 week streak 😭 The age check removed accounts when the birthday came out under 13, so the wheel probably landed on the wrong year, and we've just changed it so that can't wipe an account anymore. [CHECK: whether you can or want to restore her account or streak; it was hard-deleted, so only promise what you can do] You're welcome to sign up again with your real birthday, and I'm here if anything else goes wrong!

Eddie
replyDrafts.note: Carried since Oct 9, still unanswered. #464 stops this happening again but doesn't bring back her deleted account.
